hero.headline: The {village} Game Guide

hypha.body: No single person, not even the founders, can override a community consent vote on Hypha. That's the point. When we say {village} is community-governed, this is what makes it true.

loop.label: Sense
loop.description: Find where your gifts are most needed. A quest waiting. A gap in the land. A conversation that sparks something.

loop.label: Propose
loop.description: Open your intention to the community in Hypha. Consent-based: the check is simply whether this serves us.

loop.label: Create
loop.description: Do the work. Document it. Share what you created with the community.

hypha.intro: Hypha is the platform where every {village} decision lives, recorded, verifiable, and tamper-proof on a distributed ledger. This isn't a shared Google Doc or a Discord vote that disappears. It's an **incredibly secure, globally trusted governance system** used by communities around the world to hold their most important decisions. Your voice here is permanent. Your contributions here are real.

actions.title: Start with an Agreement
actions.subtitle: Proposing a role, quest, or new contribution
actions.description: Before you begin any new type of contribution, a seasonal role, a quest, or a new initiative, you open it to the community with an Agreement. Describe what you're bringing, what {village} receives, and what you're requesting in return. The community votes. Value in = value out.

actions.title: Claim Your Contribution
actions.subtitle: After completing a task or season
actions.description: When you've done the work, completed a quest, finished a season as a role holder, or reached a milestone, you come back and propose a Contribution Claim. Detail what you delivered and what {village} gained. This is how the value you create becomes visible.

actions.title: Propose Expenses
actions.subtitle: When your work has real costs
actions.description: If your contribution requires purchasing materials, covering travel, or paying for services that benefit the community, you can propose those expenses for reimbursement. Be transparent and specific, the community is the budget committee here, and your integrity in how you handle shared resources is part of your contribution.

actions.title: Delegate Your Voice
actions.subtitle: Trust someone to vote on your behalf
actions.description: Your voice is your governance power, it grows as you contribute. If you trust another member to represent your perspective while you're away or unavailable, you can delegate your voice to them. Choose someone whose judgment aligns with yours and whose commitment to {village} you trust deeply.

hypha.heading: Meet Hypha
hypha.valueBody: Every proposal puts one question to the community: does this contribution serve {village}? Not hours logged, hours are not a contribution. What matters is the actual value created, articulated clearly, and assessed honestly by your peers.

voice.note: **Monthly All-Village Calls:** Major cross-circle decisions happen here, with full transparency and participation.
voice.intro: {village} practices consent-based decision making where everyone's voice matters, circles hold authority within their domains, and all concerns are heard.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.description: Anyone can raise a proposal for action or change. Proposals are presented clearly with context and goals.

steps.title: Clarification
steps.description: The circle asks clarifying questions. This isn't debate, just understanding. Proposals may be refined.

steps.title: Consent
steps.description: We look for consent, not unanimous agreement. No reasoned objections means we move forward.

voice.heading: Voice & Governance

principles.body: Each circle has decision-making power within its domain. No single person overrides the circle.
principles.title: Circles Hold Authority

principles.body: A reasoned objection blocks progress. A disagreement is noted but doesn't stop the work. Know the difference.
principles.title: Objections vs. Disagreements

principles.body: We're not seeking unanimous agreement. We're looking for no reasoned objections. That's enough to move forward.
principles.title: Consent Culture

principles.body: If you see a problem, speak up. Concerns shape better decisions. Silence isn't consent.
principles.title: Anyone Can Raise Concerns

items.title: Resident Space

items.title: Prosperity Space

items.title: Land Stewardship Space

spaces.heading: The Four Spaces

closing.quote: {village} is an Infinite Game, played to keep creating together. We co-become the most beautiful village, where all beings belong and thrive. Success is measured by the flourishing of our community, land, and relationships.

progression.intro: Your journey through {village}, from first contact to deepest participation. Each stage has its own gifts and responsibilities.

elders.body: After 7+ years of deep participation, you become a Guide. Guides mentor others, hold institutional memory, and help newer members navigate their journey.
elders.title: Guide
elders.duties: **Responsibilities:** Mentorship, wisdom sharing, ceremony holding, and intergenerational connection.

elders.body: After 21+ years, a Guide may become a Sage. Sages are the living embodiment of {village}'s values and vision, holding space for the village's evolution.
elders.title: Sage
elders.duties: **Responsibilities:** Long-term vision, values stewardship, conflict resolution, and community healing.
